title: Section C SC-06: the trade id is found by "latest pending row of this token" (second resolution) instead of the inserted row id, and the buy bookkeeping is several separate writes

evidence.note: SELECT id ... WHERE token=? AND chain=? AND status=pending AND action=buy ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1; timestamp is whole seconds
V2 resolves the id by that query instead of insertTrade.run(...).lastInsertRowid

sibling_sites_checked: All three lookups (bot.ts:834, :1162, :1481) use the token query; none uses lastInsertRowid. The write sequence across db.ts/exitEngine.ts/anti-rug is shared with the DB slice (22-21) and EXIT slice (22-18).
severity_rationale: S2, bounded: two pending rows of one token exist only after a double buy (AUD-BUY-004); then both handlers can resolve the same id, arm two monitors on one exit_state row and leave the other position without one until a restart. The multi-statement sequence (insertTrade, later upsertExitState, lp_baseline) is not transactional, so a crash between them leaves partial state that the boot resume handles only in part (AUD-BUY-002 traces).
recommendation: Use the inserted row id returned by insertTrade.run for every later link (bookkeeping correctness, no trading behaviour change). The transactional grouping of the post-buy writes goes with card BUY-02.
